method: a vehicle is counted once, when its track crosses the line (the bottom centre of its box raised by 15% of its height); the browser detector and tracker of the audit (YOLO26s, 960 x 544, 5 frames a second, ByteTrack)
reference: our offline pipeline from the elimination stage: YOLO26m at 1280 px, 10 frames a second, ByteTrack, on the same clips and the same line
text: On two sample clips of a Tashkent junction, the count in this browser (YOLO26s, 5 frames a second) against our heavier offline pipeline (YOLO26m at 1280 px, 10 frames a second) on the same line: 130 and 130 vehicles at midday (5 min 40 s), 55 and 59 at dusk (2 min 8 s), 185 against 189 in all (97.9%). That is agreement between two models, not a hand count. On your own video every counted vehicle turns green as it crosses the line, and the Missed and Not a vehicle buttons correct the count by eye; the log keeps the correction, so you see how often the model needed one.
